name: Alabama
agency: Alabama Medicaid Agency with Alabama Dept. of Senior Services (E&D/ACT; AgeLine 1-800-243-5463) and Alabama Dept. of Rehabilitation Services (SAIL)

spouse.detail: limited — Personal Choices allows sons, daughters, adult grandchildren, nieces/nephews and 'in some cases, spouses'; caregiver must be 18+ and pass background screening

parentMinor.detail: no clear pathway found — these waivers/self-direction target adults and no parent-of-minor payment provision is published

pay.detail: budget set by needs assessment and regional home-care wages; reported up to ~$2,320/month; no published hourly rate

agencyModel: self-directed — participant hires/fires own caregiver; a financial management services agency handles background checks, tax withholding and caregiver payments

waitlist.detail: not an entitlement — E&D Waiver capped at 15,000/year; waitlist forms when full

apply: Contact your local Area Agency on Aging via AgeLine 1-800-243-5463 (or 1-877-425-2243), or submit Form 204/205 to your Medicaid District Office; enrollees then opt into Personal Choices.

name: Alaska
agency: Alaska Department of Health, Division of Senior and Disabilities Services (SDS), 907-269-3666

spouse.detail: no — spouses (and legal guardians) are prohibited from being hired under PCS/CDPCS; other relatives such as adult children may be hired

parentMinor.detail: limited — historically barred under PCS, but Sept 2024 waiver amendments (CCMC, IDD, ISW) allow parents/guardians to be paid for personal care, tube feedings, trach care and meds for waiver-enrolled children

pay.detail: no state-published family-caregiver wage; aggregators report ~$24–$26/hour average — actual wage set by the consumer-directed provider agency from the Medicaid PCA rate

agencyModel: self-directed under CDPCS — participant hires, trains, supervises, fires; a Consumer Directed Provider Agency acts as fiscal agent for tax withholding and caregiver payments

waitlist.detail: no waitlist — PCS and CFC are state-plan entitlements

apply: Contact a PCS provider agency or SDS to complete the PCA-08 Initial Application (doh.sds.info@alaska.gov, 907-269-3666); an Aging and Disability Resource Center can help; approval can take ~3 months.

name: Arizona
agency: Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS), 1-888-621-6880; DES Division of Developmental Disabilities for members with developmental disabilities

spouse.detail: yes — spouses can be paid, but reportedly only through a provider agency (Agency with Choice), not fully independent SDAC

parentMinor.detail: yes — PPCG made permanent by CMS approval; parents meeting Direct Care Worker requirements may provide attendant care/habilitation, capped at 40 paid hours/week per child (combined across parents) effective 7/1/2025 (HB2945)

pay.detail: typically at or near AZ minimum wage: ~$14.35/hour (2025) to ~$15.15/hour (2026); commonly reported $13–$16/hour varying by health plan and agency; ~30–40 hours/week approved

agencyModel: both routes use an agency layer: SDAC is fully self-directed (participant is employer, FMS agency runs payroll/taxes); Agency with Choice shares employer duties with a provider agency; spouses reportedly must use the agency route

waitlist.detail: no waitlist — ALTCS is an entitlement; eligibility equals enrollment

apply: Apply to ALTCS by calling 1-888-621-6880, online via Health-e-Arizona Plus, or at a local ALTCS office; families of children with developmental disabilities also work through DES/DDD.

name: Arkansas
agency: Arkansas Department of Human Services (Division of Aging, Adult, and Behavioral Health Services); Choices in Living Resource Center 866-801-3435; Division of Medical Services 501-682-8292

spouse.detail: no — spouses and legal guardians are prohibited from being hired; other relatives including adult children can be paid

parentMinor.detail: no pathway found — IndependentChoices serves adults (18+); no parent-of-minor payment provision located

pay.detail: monthly cash allowance based on assessed need, calculated at up to 78.11% of the Medicaid personal care hourly rate times authorized hours; no fixed published family-caregiver wage

agencyModel: self-directed (Cash & Counseling model) — participant is employer; a financial management service (FMS) handles tax withholding and caregiver payroll

waitlist.detail: IndependentChoices via State Plan Personal Care is an entitlement (no waitlist); the ARChoices waiver is capped (~11,500 slots/year) and can form a waitlist

apply: Apply online at Access Arkansas or at a local DHS county office with the Long-Term Services and Supports application, or call the Choices in Living Resource Center at 866-801-3435; then elect IndependentChoices.

name: California
agency: California Department of Social Services (CDSS) with DHCS; administered day-to-day by county IHSS/social services offices

spouse.detail: limited — a spouse can be a paid IHSS provider but under the 'able and available spouse' rule is compensable only for personal care and paramedical services, not domestic/related services

parentMinor.detail: yes — AB 1287 (effective 2024) eliminated the old restrictions (no-other-provider and left-employment tests); parents of minor recipients now enroll on the same basis as any provider with background check

pay.detail: county-negotiated wages ~$16.90–$22+/hour (2026); state minimum $16.90/hour as of 1/1/2026; statewide average IHSS cost ~$21.85/hour (2025–26 state budget estimate)

agencyModel: fully self-directed — recipient is the employer who hires/fires/supervises; no agency required; the state/county payroll system (CMIPS) issues paychecks and withholds taxes

waitlist.detail: no waitlist — IHSS is a state-plan entitlement

apply: Contact the IHSS office in your county and submit an Application for In-Home Supportive Services (SOC 295); a county social worker then does an in-home needs assessment.

name: Colorado
agency: Dept. of Health Care Policy & Financing (HCPF) / Health First Colorado, via local Case Management Agencies; Member Contact Center 1-800-221-3943

spouse.detail: yes — spouses can be hired under CDASS/IHSS; spouse-as-LRP homemaker capped at 7 hrs/week

parentMinor.detail: yes — via CFC/IHSS personal care ('extraordinary care' required) or by becoming a certified Family CNA paid through a home health agency

pay.detail: ~$17–$20/hr; floor = minimum wage ($17.00 statewide, $19.29 Denver, Jan 2026); employer sets wage within allocation

agencyModel: self-directed: CDASS uses an FMS (fiscal management service) vendor for payroll only; IHSS and Family CNA route through a licensed IHSS/home-health agency

waitlist.detail: no waitlist — CFC is a state plan entitlement (since 7/1/2025); EBD waiver also historically no waitlist

apply: Contact the local Case Management Agency (Single Entry Point) for a nursing-facility level-of-care assessment; must be enrolled in Health First Colorado (Medicaid) first.

name: Connecticut
agency: CT Dept. of Social Services, Community Options Unit; 1-800-445-5394 (option 4)

spouse.detail: no — spouses excluded under AFL, CFC, and the PCA waiver

parentMinor.detail: limited — parents of minors/legal guardians excluded from CFC/PCA; since 2023 the three DDS developmental-disability waivers pay parents of school-age children for respite/day/personal supports, capped at 800 awake hrs/yr (guardians of adults: 2,100 hrs/yr)

pay.detail: AFL live-in caregiver stipend up to ~$500/week (~$2,400/month, tax-free), set at 4 assessment levels; CFC/PCA hourly rate

agencyModel: AFL requires a sponsoring/intermediary agency that supports and pays the caregiver; CFC/PCA are self-directed with a fiscal intermediary handling payroll

waitlist.detail: CHCPE Medicaid waiver is slot-capped (~22,066/yr) and can waitlist; CFC is an entitlement with no waitlist

apply: Call the DSS Community Options Unit or submit the CHCPE Request for Referral form; a care manager performs an in-home functional assessment.

name: Delaware
agency: Delaware Health & Social Services, Division of Medicaid & Medical Assistance (DMMA); Central Intake 1-866-940-8963, Customer Relations 1-866-843-7212

spouse.detail: yes — spouses and other relatives can be hired under DSHP-Plus self-directed attendant care (the separate state-funded Personal Attendant Services program excludes spouses)

parentMinor.detail: yes — parents/guardians can be paid for personal care up to 40 hrs/week under the demonstration waiver; another adult must sign timesheets/paperwork

pay.detail: reported ~$13–$21/hr, avg ~$16.75/hr (2026, secondhand)

agencyModel: self-directed through the member's managed care organization; a financial management services agency handles payroll/taxes/background checks

waitlist.detail: no waitlist — DSHP-Plus is an entitlement (eligibility = enrollment)

apply: Call the DMMA Central Intake Unit at 866-940-8963 to request an application; eligibility determination (financial + nursing-facility level of care) can take up to 3 months.

name: District of Columbia
agency: DC Department of Health Care Finance (DHCF), Long Term Care Administration, 202-442-5988; Dept. of Aging and Community Living (DACL) 202-724-5626

spouse.detail: no — 'a spouse or other legally responsible relative is excluded' from being a paid caregiver under Services My Way

parentMinor.detail: no — EPD Waiver serves people 65+ or persons with disabilities 18+; minors are not in this waiver

pay.detail: not published; participant sets wages within their budget — reported ~$3,600/month max on third-party sites

agencyModel: no home-care agency for self-directed services; a financial management services provider is required — GT Independence serves DC Services My Way as FMS and support broker (877-659-4500)

waitlist.detail: not an entitlement — enrollment slots limited and a waitlist can form when full

apply: A doctor or nurse completes the EPD Waiver Prescription Order Form, submitted to Liberty Healthcare, which schedules the functional assessment and assigns a worker to help complete the application; DHCF Long Term Care Administration (202-442-5988) administers enrollment.

name: Florida
agency: Agency for Health Care Administration (AHCA) administers SMMC-LTC/FHHA; Dept. of Elder Affairs/ADRC screening (Elder Helpline 1-800-963-5337); APD runs CDC+ (helpline 1-866-761-7043)

spouse.detail: limited — yes under SMMC-LTC PDO (must be 'extraordinary care' beyond normal spousal duties, background screening required); no under CDC+

parentMinor.detail: yes — FHHA program pays a trained parent $25/hr (up to 8 hrs/day) for a PDN-eligible child under 21; 1915(j) also lets parents of minors on iBudget be paid for self-directed personal care via CDC+

pay.detail: FHHA: $25/hr statutory (2023 law); PDO: set by each managed-care plan, ~$15/hr floor for unskilled care reported

agencyModel: PDO is self-directed with the plan/fiscal agent handling payroll; CDC+ is self-directed with a state Fiscal/Employer Agent; FHHA requires employment through a licensed home health agency

waitlist.detail: yes — SMMC-LTC is not an entitlement: waitlist ranked by frailty priority score (not wait time); iBudget/CDC+ waitlist is years long (10+ yrs for non-crisis categories)

apply: Call the local Aging & Disability Resource Center (Elder Helpline 1-800-963-5337) for the phone screening that sets the priority score; CARES assessment + Medicaid application follow when a slot opens. For children/FHHA contact a participating home health agency; for CDC+ go through APD.

name: Georgia
agency: GA Dept. of Community Health (Medicaid) with DHS Division of Aging Services running CCSP/SOURCE via Area Agencies on Aging (1-866-552-4464); DBHDD for NOW/COMP

spouse.detail: limited — no under SFC and CCSP/SOURCE consumer direction; reported allowed under NOW/COMP live-in family caregiver participant-direction

parentMinor.detail: limited — no under SFC/CCSP (parents of minors barred); yes under GAPP family caregiver option for medically fragile children under 21 (personal care only, not skilled nursing, prior authorization required)

pay.detail: SFC daily stipend reported ~$80/day in 2026 (~$1,987–$2,400/month by acuity tier), paid weekly, generally tax-free; NOW/COMP hourly rates per DBHDD fee schedule

agencyModel: SFC requires a live-in caregiver enrolled through a licensed SFC provider agency (agency provides oversight + pays stipend); NOW/COMP self-direction uses a fiscal intermediary; GAPP goes through a home care agency

waitlist.detail: CCSP is slot-capped and can waitlist; SOURCE (SSI-linked) generally no waitlist; NOW/COMP have a multi-year DBHDD planning list with crisis exceptions

apply: For seniors: call the Area Agency on Aging / ADRC at 866-552-4464 for CCSP or SOURCE screening, then choose an SFC provider agency; for I/DD, apply to NOW/COMP via the DBHDD regional field office; Medicaid application is filed separately with DFCS.

name: Hawaii
agency: Hawaii Dept. of Human Services, Med-QUEST Division (MQD); 800-316-8005 (O'ahu 808-524-3370); ADRC 808-643-2372

spouse.detail: yes — relatives including spouses and adult children can be hired under QI self-direction

parentMinor.detail: limited — self-direction allows hiring relatives, but payment of a parent for a minor child is not documented; confirm with Med-QUEST

pay.detail: no official published rate; third-party reports ~$14–$23/hr depending on program/region, up to ~$3,028/mo (2026)

agencyModel: self-directed: participant hires the caregiver; a financial management services (FMS) agency handles payroll/taxes; services authorized through the member's QI health plan (MCO)

waitlist.detail: Medicaid/QI enrollment is an entitlement, but HCBS/LTSS participant slots can be limited — waitlist can form when full

apply: Apply for Med-QUEST online at MyBenefits or with form DHS 1100 at a Med-QUEST Service Center (800-316-8005); once enrolled, request a long-term-services assessment through the QI health plan.

name: Idaho
agency: Idaho Dept. of Health & Welfare, Bureau of Long Term Care; 877-456-1233 (Medicaid 800-962-2537)

spouse.detail: no — spouses are prohibited as paid PCS/attendant caregivers except narrow extraordinary-circumstances exceptions; the temporary spousal FPCS program ended 7/15/2025

parentMinor.detail: limited/no — A&D programs serve adults; parents of minor children are generally not payable under these programs (children served via separate programs)

pay.detail: no published state rate for family caregivers; third-party reports up to ~$2,554/mo via waiver self-direction (2026)

agencyModel: State Plan PCS requires a licensed Personal Assistance Agency (no self-direction); A&D Waiver allows self-directing attendant/chore/companion/homemaker services with an FMS agency handling payroll; CFH requires certifying the caregiver's home

waitlist.detail: State Plan PCS is an entitlement (no waitlist); A&D Waiver is capped (~15,095 slots/yr) — waitlist possible, access by application date

apply: Apply via idalink.idaho.gov, by phone 877-456-1233, or at a local DHW office; the Bureau of Long Term Care performs the nursing-facility level-of-care assessment (allow up to ~3 months).

name: Illinois
agency: Illinois Dept. on Aging (CCP; Senior HelpLine 800-252-8966); IDHS Division of Rehabilitation Services (HSP; 877-581-3690); HFS is the Medicaid agency

spouse.detail: limited — CCP: yes, any family member including a spouse may be hired (recent expansion, via agency with background check + 24-hr training); HSP: no, spouses excluded as legally responsible relatives

parentMinor.detail: limited — HSP excludes parents of a minor recipient; MFTD waiver pays parents who hold an RN/LPN license for skilled nursing (paid-CNA parent option proposed 2025, not yet approved)

pay.detail: HSP individual providers: $19.50/hr Jan 2026 rising to $20.00/hr Jul 2026 (SEIU contract; seniority add-ons up to +$4/hr); CCP aides are paid by the contracted agency, reported ~$18–$20/hr

agencyModel: CCP: caregiver must be hired and supervised by a contracted In-Home Services agency; HSP: consumer-directed — customer hires the personal assistant directly and the state handles payroll; MFTD: parent-nurse employed via nursing agency

waitlist.detail: generally no waitlist — CCP and HSP enroll eligible applicants without waiver waitlists

apply: Age 60+: call the Senior HelpLine 800-252-8966 to reach the local Care Coordination Unit for a CCP assessment; under 60: apply through the local DHS-DRS Home Services Program office; medically fragile children: contact UIC DSCC.

name: Indiana
agency: Indiana FSSA (Division of Aging / Indiana Medicaid); intake via local Area Agency on Aging — INconnect Alliance 800-986-3505

spouse.detail: yes via SFC — a live-in spouse can be the paid SFC caregiver; no for Attendant Care since 7/1/2024 (spouse is a Legally Responsible Individual)

parentMinor.detail: yes via SFC on the Health & Wellness waiver — biological/adoptive parents, guardians, and stepparents of a minor may provide SFC; parents/guardians of minors may NOT provide attendant care since 7/1/2024

pay.detail: SFC program rates eff. 7/1/2025: $77.54/day (Level 1), $99.71 (Level 2), $133.44 (Level 3); provider must pass through at least 60% to the caregiver (tax-free difficulty-of-care stipend, roughly $46–$80/day); attendant care is hourly via agency (rate varies)

agencyModel: SFC: caregiver must enroll with an approved SFC provider agency that supervises and pays the stipend; attendant care may be agency-based or participant-directed, but LRIs are barred from self-directed attendant care (Indiana Code 12-10-17.1-10(b))

waitlist.detail: yes — PathWays and Health & Wellness reached federally approved capacity (waitlist since Apr 2024; 10,000+ waiting in 2025; capacity hit again Dec 2025 with new invitations not expected before ~Jul 2026); FSSA runs an online waitlist dashboard

apply: Contact the local Area Agency on Aging for intake, level-of-care assessment, and waitlist placement; apply for Indiana Medicaid through FSSA; PathWays members then select a managed-care plan and request SFC through their care coordinator.

name: Iowa
agency: Iowa HHS / Iowa Medicaid (member services 800-338-8366), delivered through managed-care organizations (Iowa Total Care, Wellpoint)

spouse.detail: no — a spouse cannot be the paid attendant under CDAC or CCO

parentMinor.detail: no — parents/stepparents/guardians of a child 17 or under cannot be paid (441 IAC 77.30); a new Medical Day Care for Children service may allow parent pay for medically fragile children

pay.detail: CCO: member sets worker wages from a monthly individual budget (no single published rate); third-party reports up to ~$2,691/mo (2026)

agencyModel: CCO is self-directed: the member is the employer, Veridian Fiscal Solutions is the financial management service running payroll (319-226-4692), with an optional Independent Support Broker; otherwise services must come through an enrolled agency provider

waitlist.detail: Elderly Waiver: no waitlist (Jan 2026, ~10,653 slots); most other Iowa waivers have waitlists — ~26,665 Iowans waiting statewide as of Dec 2025 (Intellectual Disability waiver longest)

apply: Apply for Medicaid and the appropriate HCBS waiver through Iowa HHS (hhs.iowa.gov or a local office, 800-338-8366); after waiver approval and level-of-care assessment, ask the case manager to enroll in the Consumer Choices Option.

name: Kansas
agency: Kansas Dept. for Aging and Disability Services (KDADS); KanCare Clearinghouse 800-792-4884, ADRC 855-200-2372

spouse.detail: yes — spouse can be hired under FE/PD self-directed attendant care

parentMinor.detail: yes — TA Waiver pays parents for personal care up to 12 hrs/day (40 hrs/wk, no overnight respite; nursing if parent is RN/LPN); BI and PD waivers also permanently allow paid parents of minors

pay.detail: ~$13–$17/hr for self-directed attendant care, set by KDADS by region (SFY2026, reported)

agencyModel: self-directed hire/train/fire, but a Financial Management Services (FMS) agency must handle payroll/taxes

waitlist.detail: FE Waiver: new waitlist for FE applicants effective July 6 2026; PD waitlist eliminated end of FY2025; BI at risk of first-time waitlist after 2025 budget cuts

apply: Apply for KanCare online (Self-Service Portal), by phone 800-792-4884, or paper, checking the HCBS box; ADRC (855-200-2372) arranges the functional assessment.

name: Kentucky
agency: KY Cabinet for Health and Family Services — Dept. for Aging and Independent Living (DAIL) 877-315-0589; Waiver Help Desk 844-784-5614

spouse.detail: yes — friends and relatives including adult children and spouses can be hired under PDS

parentMinor.detail: limited — parents/guardians (legally responsible individuals) payable under Michelle P./HCB only for extraordinary or specialized care (rule eff. 7/1/2024), capped 40 hrs/wk combined, CPR training required

pay.detail: PDS attendant care max reimbursement $29.04/hr (reported 2026; caregiver take-home is lower after FMS costs)

agencyModel: self-directed with mandatory financial management services agency for payroll/taxes; support broker/case manager assists

waitlist.detail: HCB Waiver ~17,800 slots/yr — waitlist forms when full; Michelle P. Waiver has a long-standing multi-year waitlist

apply: Apply via kynect.ky.gov, phone 855-306-8959, or in person; PDS enrollment goes through the case manager or the regional Area Development District/AAA.

name: Louisiana
agency: Louisiana Dept. of Health — Office of Aging and Adult Services (OAAS); Louisiana Options in Long Term Care 877-456-1146

spouse.detail: yes — MIHC allows a live-in spouse or adult child as the paid caregiver

parentMinor.detail: limited — not under CCW (serves adults 65+ or 21+ with disabilities); parents of minors payable under Children's Choice/New Opportunities DD waivers, 40 hrs/wk cap, cannot also be the employer/representative

pay.detail: MIHC pays a tiered per-diem stipend by acuity, reported ~$85–$150/day (up to ~$1,800/month); consumer-directed hourly rate not published

agencyModel: MIHC runs through an enrolled MIHC provider agency (care manager + nurse support, agency pays the stipend); consumer-directed option uses a financial management services agency for payroll

waitlist.detail: not an entitlement — waitlist via the CCW Request for Services Registry when slots are full

apply: Call Louisiana Options in Long Term Care at 877-456-1146 to request CCW services and be placed on the registry; OAAS handles level-of-care screening.

name: Maine
agency: Maine DHHS — Office of Aging and Disability Services (OADS) 855-797-4357; assessments by Maximus 833-525-5784

spouse.detail: limited — spouses/legally responsible relatives excluded from CDAS and Section 19 hires, EXCEPT Resolves 2019 ch.104 lets a spouse be paid as a Personal Support Specialist for members needing extraordinary care

parentMinor.detail: limited — new Family Home Health Aide Program (implementation from early 2026) will reimburse parents of minors; parents who are nurses payable in exceptional circumstances

pay.detail: reported ~$17–$27/hr for family caregivers under CDAS/Section 19 (2026, third-party figure)

agencyModel: member is the employer (hires/trains/fires); a fiscal intermediary is required for background checks, taxes, and payments

waitlist.detail: Section 12 CDAS is an entitlement — no waitlist; Section 19 waiver capped (~4,126 slots) and a waitlist forms when full

apply: Apply for MaineCare via My Maine Connection, 855-797-4357, or a district DHHS office; Maximus (833-525-5784) does the functional assessment.

name: Maryland
agency: Maryland Dept. of Health — Office of Long Term Services and Supports, CFC 410-767-1739; Maryland Access Point (MAP) 844-627-5465

spouse.detail: yes — spouse or adult child can be hired under CFC self-direction, provided they are not the participant's guardian or program representative

parentMinor.detail: limited — not via CFC (guardian/representative bar); DDA Community Pathways Waiver pays legally responsible parents up to 40 hrs/wk, and the Autism Waiver reimburses extraordinary care

pay.detail: reported ~$16–$20/hr depending on region and care level (2026, third-party figure; state sets the range)

agencyModel: caregiver enrolls through a Medicaid personal assistance agency and a fiscal intermediary handles payroll/taxes; participant still selects and directs the caregiver

waitlist.detail: CFC and CPAS are entitlements — no waitlist; Community Options Waiver has a large registry (~20,616 people as of early 2026, ~700 invited/month)

apply: Call the CFC program (410-767-1739) or MAP (844-627-5465) / visit a local MAP office to start eligibility screening; processing takes up to ~3 months.

name: Massachusetts
agency: MassHealth / Executive Office of Health and Human Services (EOHHS), 800-841-2900

spouse.detail: no — spouse barred as legally responsible relative in both PCA and AFC

parentMinor.detail: no — parent of a minor member cannot be paid PCA (legally responsible relative); parents of ADULT children can be paid

pay.detail: PCA: $19.50/hr base (7/1/2024), +$0.50 7/1/2025, seniority scale $19.50–$23.25/hr, +$3.25/hr complex-care differential from 1/1/2026 (1199SEIU contract); AFC: tax-free stipend ~$1,000/mo (Level I) to ~$1,600/mo (Level II)

agencyModel: PCA: self-directed — consumer is the employer, works with a Personal Care Management agency and a fiscal intermediary (e.g., Tempus Unlimited) for payroll; AFC: caregiver must go through a MassHealth-contracted AFC provider agency

waitlist.detail: PCA is an entitlement — no waitlist; AFC no waitlist reported

apply: Apply for MassHealth via the Application for Health Coverage for Seniors/Long-Term Care to a MassHealth Enrollment Center, then get a PCA evaluation through a Personal Care Management agency (or contact an AFC provider agency for AFC).

name: Michigan
agency: Michigan Department of Health and Human Services (MDHHS), via county MDHHS offices; MI Choice via regional waiver agencies

spouse.detail: limited — spouses barred under Home Help; reportedly payable under MI Choice Self-Determination Option

parentMinor.detail: no under Home Help (parents of minors excluded); other adult relatives 18+ allowed

pay.detail: Home Help individual caregiver: $15.88/hr (eff. 11/1/2024), rising to $17.13/hr ($13.73 + $3.40 pass-through) eff. 1/1/2026 (MDHHS rate bulletins)

agencyModel: self-directed allowed — client hires an individual caregiver who enrolls as a provider in CHAMPS with background check and is paid directly by MDHHS (agency caregivers optional); MI Choice SDO uses a fiscal intermediary

waitlist.detail: Home Help is an entitlement — no waitlist; MI Choice waiver has capped slots and regional waitlists

apply: Contact your county MDHHS office to apply for Home Help and request an adult-services assessment; for MI Choice contact your regional waiver agency for a screening.

name: Minnesota
agency: Minnesota Department of Human Services (DHS); county long-term care consultation teams; Senior LinkAge Line 800-333-2433

spouse.detail: yes — since 10/1/2024 spouses can be paid CFSS/PCA workers (per MN DHS bulletin); spouses also hirable under CDCS

parentMinor.detail: yes — since 10/1/2024 parents of minors can be paid CFSS workers (per MN DHS bulletin)

pay.detail: paid-spouse/paid-parent-of-minor CFSS maximum rate ~$22.74/hr (~2025); CDCS wages set by participant within an individual budget

agencyModel: fiscal support: CFSS offers an agency-provider model or a self-directed budget model with a Financial Management Services (FMS) provider; CDCS requires an FMS provider for payroll/taxes

waitlist.detail: CFSS is a state-plan entitlement — no waitlist; Elderly Waiver capped (~40,083/yr) — waitlist can form

apply: Start with a MnCHOICES/long-term care consultation assessment through your county (or call the Senior LinkAge Line); also apply for Medical Assistance (MA-LTC application).

name: Mississippi
agency: Mississippi Division of Medicaid, Office of Long Term Care, 800-421-2408; MAC Center 844-822-4622; IL Waiver operated by MS Dept. of Rehabilitation Services, 800-443-1000

spouse.detail: no — spouses excluded; E&D Waiver has no consumer direction at all

parentMinor.detail: no — current waiver language bars payment to parents/guardians/legally responsible individuals (pandemic-era flexibility removed)

pay.detail: no published family-caregiver pay rate

agencyModel: E&D: agency-delivered only — family cannot be hired; IL Waiver: participant-directed — friends and some relatives (e.g., adult children NOT living with the participant) can be hired

waitlist.detail: both are capped waivers with waitlists — E&D ~22,200 slots/yr, IL ~5,800 slots/yr, slots awarded by application date

apply: Contact your regional Mississippi Division of Medicaid office or the MAC Center (844-822-4622) to request a waiver assessment; for the IL Waiver contact MS Dept. of Rehabilitation Services.

name: Missouri
agency: Missouri Dept. of Health & Senior Services, Division of Senior and Disability Services (DSDS); HCBS referral line 866-835-3505; financial eligibility via Family Support Division 855-373-4636

spouse.detail: limited — CDS bars spouses and legal guardians; SFCW explicitly allows a spouse or legal guardian to be the paid live-in caregiver (dementia diagnosis required)

parentMinor.detail: no — CDS consumers must be adults able to self-direct; no MO program paying parents of minor children found

pay.detail: CDS attendants: ~$12–$20/hr depending on vendor, e.g. Paraquad $15.50/hr as of 7/2025; SFCW pays a daily stipend via provider agency

agencyModel: CDS: self-directed but must enroll with a state-contracted CDS vendor/fiscal agent that handles payroll; SFCW: caregiver is employed and paid by a DSS-enrolled Structured Family Caregiving provider agency

waitlist.detail: CDS/Personal Care is an entitlement — no waitlist; SFCW capped at ~300 participants — waitlist possible

apply: Apply for MO HealthNet (myDSS online or 855-373-9994), then submit an HCBS referral (866-835-3505 or online HCBS referral form) for a DSDS in-home assessment.

name: Montana
agency: Montana DPHHS, Senior & Long Term Care Division (406-444-4077); Public Assistance Helpline 888-706-1535

spouse.detail: limited — yes under Big Sky Waiver self-directed option; prohibited under CFCS/PCS (spouses and parents of minors excluded there)

parentMinor.detail: no under CFCS/PCS (explicitly prohibited); Big Sky Waiver serves adults — parent-of-minor not addressed

pay.detail: not published on fetched pages

agencyModel: hybrid — member hires/fires the caregiver but a financial management services / provider agency handles payroll, taxes, background checks; agency-based model also available

waitlist.detail: BSW: yes, limited slots (~2,800/yr, waitlist forms when full); CFCS/PCS: entitlement, no waitlist

apply: Apply for Montana Medicaid at apply.mt.gov or a local Office of Public Assistance (helpline 888-706-1535); Mountain Pacific Quality Health does the functional assessment (800-219-7035).

name: Nebraska
agency: Nebraska DHHS (main 402-471-3121; AD Waiver 877-667-6266)

spouse.detail: no — dhhs.ne.gov: 'a spouse or the parent/guardian of a minor child cannot be paid providers'

parentMinor.detail: no — explicitly excluded on dhhs.ne.gov (legally responsible persons)

pay.detail: PAS fee schedule ~$3.75/15 min = ~$15.00/hr for independent providers

agencyModel: no agency required — family member enrolls as a Medicaid independent provider, paid directly by DHHS; EVV via smartphone required; agency option also exists

waitlist.detail: PAS: entitlement, never a waitlist; AD Waiver: capped (~10,000/yr), waitlist possible with priority for health/safety risk

apply: Apply online via iServe Nebraska or at a local DHHS office; for the AD Waiver call 877-667-6266 to request materials.

name: Nevada
agency: Nevada Medicaid / DHCFP under the Nevada Health Authority (prior-authorization line 800-525-2395); ADSD operates the SFCG Waiver (local ADSD offices)

spouse.detail: limited — no under PCS (spouses/legally responsible persons excluded); yes under the SFCG Waiver, spouse can be the paid caregiver

parentMinor.detail: no under PCS (explicitly: 'spouses, legal guardians, and parents of minors, cannot be paid'); SFCG is for adults with dementia so not applicable

pay.detail: PCS hourly rate not published on fetched pages; SFCG pays a daily stipend — caregiver must receive at least 65% of the Medicaid per diem rate

agencyModel: yes — self-directed PCS must run through an enrolled ISO (Provider Type 83) that handles payroll/taxes/background checks; SFCG paid via a home care agency or ISO; traditional agency model also available

waitlist.detail: PCS: entitlement, never a waitlist; SFCG Waiver: capped (~156 slots in 2026), waitlist forms when full

apply: Apply for Nevada Medicaid via Access Nevada, then call the prior-authorization line (800-525-2395) to request a PCS assessment; for SFCG contact your local ADSD office with the dementia verification form.

name: New Hampshire
agency: NH DHHS Bureau of Adult and Aging Services (ADRC/ServiceLink 866-634-9412; DHHS Customer Services 844-275-3447); Granite State Independent Living runs PCAS intake (800-826-3700)

spouse.detail: yes — CFI participant-directed and PCAS both allow hiring a spouse (PCAS: caregiver may not be the participant's durable power of attorney)

parentMinor.detail: limited — CFI/PCAS are adult programs; the In-Home Supports Waiver for children with DD can pay parents for some services when the child's dependency exceeds DD peers

pay.detail: reported $15–$22/hr for family caregivers

agencyModel: hybrid — participant hires/manages the caregiver but a financial management services agency handles payroll, taxes, background checks

waitlist.detail: CFI: not an entitlement (~5,951 cap/yr), waitlist exists; PCAS: entitlement, no waitlist

apply: Apply via NH Easy online or a district DHHS office; ServiceLink/ADRC (866-634-9412) assists with CFI; for PCAS enroll in NH Medicaid then submit a Request for Services to Granite State Independent Living.

name: New Jersey
agency: NJ Department of Human Services, Division of Medical Assistance & Health Services (PPP office 609-631-2481)

spouse.detail: yes — spouse, adult child, sibling, relative, friend, or neighbor can be hired as the paid PCA

parentMinor.detail: no — parent of a minor Medicaid recipient is categorically excluded per the federal 1915(j) rule; guardians of incapacitated adults CAN be paid if someone else serves as authorized representative

pay.detail: monthly cash budget based on assessed PCA hours; dollar amounts not published

agencyModel: self-directed (participant is employer) but a fiscal intermediary is mandatory: Palco (Horizon NJ Health) or Public Partnerships LLC/PPL (Aetna, Fidelis, UnitedHealthcare, Wellpoint); FI transition in progress 2025-26

waitlist.detail: no waitlist — entitlement for those approved for PCA services

apply: Enroll in NJ FamilyCare Plan A, then call your Managed Care Organization to request a PCA assessment and PPP enrollment; PPP helpline 609-631-2481.

name: New Mexico
agency: New Mexico Health Care Authority (HCA); Aging & Disability Resource Center 800-432-2080; Consolidated Customer Service Center 800-283-4465

spouse.detail: yes — spouses are Legally Responsible Individuals (LRIs) and can be paid once the member's MCO completes a needs assessment and approves the LRI

parentMinor.detail: yes — parent or guardian of a minor is an LRI and can be paid with MCO approval; reported LRI cap of 40 hrs/week and extraordinary-care requirement for personal care

pay.detail: no published rate; SDCB member/EOR negotiates caregiver wages within the approved annual budget (adult budget reported up to ~$85,767/yr)

agencyModel: ABCB: caregiver must become an employee of a home health agency; SDCB: member or their Employer of Record hires directly with a Support Broker, and a financial management agency runs payroll; SDCB requires ~120 days in agency-directed care first

waitlist.detail: Community Benefit waiver pathway serves ~6,989/yr; a 'Central Registry' waitlist can form when slots fill

apply: Apply for Medicaid via the YesNM portal, 800-283-4465, or an Income Support Division field office; existing members ask their MCO Care Coordinator to approve the family/LRI caregiver.

name: New York
agency: New York State Department of Health; Medicaid Helpline 1-800-541-2831; local county Department of Social Services determines eligibility

spouse.detail: no — spouses cannot be hired as CDPAP personal assistants

parentMinor.detail: no — parents cannot be paid caregivers for their own children under 21 (they can be paid for adult children 21+)

pay.detail: PPL minimum base wages eff. 1/1/2026: $20.65/hr NYC, $20.05/hr Nassau/Suffolk/Westchester, $18.65/hr rest of state, plus paid leave/benefits

agencyModel: self-directed (consumer recruits, hires, trains), but since 4/1/2025 every consumer and PA must register with PPL (Public Partnerships LLC), the single statewide fiscal intermediary that runs payroll

waitlist.detail: no waitlist — CFCO/CDPAP is an entitlement; new 'Minimum Needs' eligibility requirements for most new adult applicants since Sept 2025

apply: Apply through the county Department of Social Services (or Medicaid Helpline); enrolled members go through their care manager/MLTC plan, then consumer and caregiver register with PPL.

name: North Carolina
agency: NC Medicaid Division of Health Benefits (NCDHHS); NC LIFTSS 1-833-470-0597

spouse.detail: yes — spouse can be hired under CAP/Consumer-Directed, and family members including spouses can be the paid live-in 'supportive worker' under Coordinated Caregiving

parentMinor.detail: yes/limited — CAP/C pays parents via three routes: self-direction with an extraordinary circumstance, an RN/LPN/CNA-certified-parent pathway, or Coordinated Caregiving (background check, lives with child, CPR); LRP paid work reportedly capped at 40 hrs/week

pay.detail: no published family-caregiver rate on pages reviewed

agencyModel: consumer-directed, but a financial management services agency handles payroll/taxes; Coordinated Caregiving runs through a participating agency

waitlist.detail: yes — CAP/DA is capped (~14,078 participants/yr) with county-specific waitlists

apply: Contact a CAP/DA (or CAP/C) case management provider in your county to request a referral, and apply for NC Medicaid via ePASS or the local DSS office.

name: North Dakota
agency: North Dakota Health and Human Services, Aging Services Division; Aging and Disability Resource Link 1-855-462-5465

spouse.detail: yes — HCBS waiver Family Personal Care pays a spouse, adult child, or adult grandchild who lives with the participant; spouses and legal guardians are excluded from MSP-PC; pilot also covers spouses as LRIs

parentMinor.detail: yes via pilot — Family Paid Caregiver Pilot pays legally responsible individuals (parent/guardian) providing extraordinary care on the Autism Birth-17, Medically Fragile, Children's Hospice, and Traditional IID/DD waivers

pay.detail: pilot reported at $77.45/day for a child under 18 and $154.89/day for an adult; individual QSP personal-care rate reported up to ~$21.76/hr

agencyModel: no home-care agency, but the family caregiver must enroll as a Qualified Service Provider (QSP) with ND HHS; the waiver has no fully self-directed option

waitlist.detail: HCBS waiver is not an entitlement (~930 slots/yr) and a waitlist forms when full; pilot is capacity-limited (reported 75 families enrolled of 550+ applicants)

apply: Apply for the HCBS waiver online or through your local Human Service Zone office; the pilot is applied for through the Family Paid Caregiver Portal (familycaregiver.hhs.nd.gov).

name: Ohio
agency: Ohio Department of Aging (PASSPORT Helpline 1-866-243-5678); Ohio Department of Medicaid (Consumer Hotline 1-800-324-8680); Ohio Benefits Helpline 1-844-640-6446

spouse.detail: yes — spouses can be hired under PASSPORT's participant-directed options, Next Generation MyCare, and as the live-in Structured Family Caregiving caregiver

parentMinor.detail: limited — Ohio Home Care Waiver and the three DD waivers pay parents/guardians of minors, but the parent must work for an agency, be the provider of last resort, and generally work 40 hrs or less; RN/LPN parents can provide paid nursing; litigation pending over these rules

pay.detail: no state-published rates on pages reviewed; C-HCAS lets the participant set the hourly rate within a budget, CD-PCS uses a state-set rate, and SFC pays a tiered daily stipend third-party-reported at ~$1,500-$3,000/month

agencyModel: participant-directed options use a financial management services agency for payroll/taxes; SFC runs through an SFC agency; parents of minors on the Home Care Waiver must be agency-employed

waitlist.detail: PASSPORT is capped (~39,807/yr) and a waitlist can form; Next Generation MyCare has no cap and no waitlist

apply: Apply for Ohio Medicaid via the Ohio Benefits portal or county Job and Family Services and answer yes to the waiver/long-term-care question; for PASSPORT call the PASSPORT Helpline (Area Agency on Aging screening).

name: Oklahoma
agency: Oklahoma Human Services (OKDHS), Community Living, Aging and Protective Services — 800-435-4711 / 918-933-4900 (CD-PASS unit)

spouse.detail: limited — spouse can be hired 'only in rare situations'; adult children, siblings, grandchildren, nieces/nephews routinely allowed

parentMinor.detail: no — ADvantage serves adults; parents of minors not covered by this waiver

pay.detail: member negotiates wage within a budget cap; older handbook max $11.46/hr PSA, $13.80/hr Advanced PSA

agencyModel: self-directed (member is employer); Acumen Fiscal Agent is the required fiscal/financial management agent

waitlist.detail: not an entitlement — limited slots (~26,972/yr) and a waitlist forms when full

apply: Apply to OKDHS via the online long-term care intake or call 800-435-4711; once on ADvantage, ask the case manager for the CD-PASS option.

name: Oregon
agency: Oregon Department of Human Services, Aging and People with Disabilities (APD) — 800-282-8096; ADRC 1-855-673-2372

spouse.detail: yes — spouses can be hired under ICP and the dedicated Spousal Pay Program (spouse must enroll as a provider with the Oregon Home Care Commission)

parentMinor.detail: limited — parents of minors historically excluded; new Children's Extraordinary Needs Waiver (2024) pays parents up to 20 hrs/wk but capped at 155 families (230 from 7/1/2026)

pay.detail: ICP: participant sets wage from a monthly cash budget (at least minimum wage); state-paid homecare workers earn $20-$24.10/hr under the 2025-27 SEIU/OHCC contract

agencyModel: fully self-directed — participant is the employer; fiscal-agency help optional under ICP; Spousal Pay caregivers need an OHCC provider number

waitlist.detail: ICP: not an entitlement — waitlist can form when slots fill; Spousal Pay Program is an entitlement with no waitlist

apply: Contact the local Area Agency on Aging / APD office or call ODHS at 800-282-8096 (ADRC 1-855-673-2372) to request an assessment and ask for Independent Choices or Spousal Pay.

name: Pennsylvania
agency: PA Department of Human Services, Office of Long-Term Living (OLTL) — CHC Participant Hotline 1-833-735-4416

spouse.detail: no — spouses and legal guardians cannot be paid; other relatives incl. adult children and parents of adult (21+) disabled children can

parentMinor.detail: no for CHC (serves adults 21+); PA generally does not pay parents of minor children

pay.detail: negotiated per direct care worker, roughly $13-$19/hr reported, subject to county-band maximum rates on the Tempus PA rate sheet

agencyModel: self-directed with a mandatory fiscal intermediary — Tempus Unlimited is the statewide FMS for CHC/Services My Way

waitlist.detail: limited enrollment slots (~181,848/yr); waitlist can form when full

apply: Call the PA Independent Enrollment Broker at 1-877-550-4227 (or its online Community Referral Form) to start CHC eligibility; then choose participant-direction/Services My Way with your MCO service coordinator.

name: Rhode Island
agency: RI Executive Office of Health and Human Services (EOHHS) / DHS — DHS Call Center 855-697-4347; The Point (ADRC) 401-462-4444

spouse.detail: no — spouses are prohibited from being hired in both Personal Choice and the IP Program (adult children and other relatives allowed)

parentMinor.detail: no — programs serve the adult LTSS population; parent-of-minor payment not addressed

pay.detail: participant sets the PCA wage within budget limits — reported range minimum wage up to $15.00/hr

agencyModel: self-directed; a state-contracted service advisement agency + fiscal intermediary handle payroll and taxes (Personal Choice via AccessPointRI / Seven Hills RI / Tri-County)

waitlist.detail: not necessarily an entitlement — slots may be limited and waiting lists may develop (no active waitlist confirmed)

apply: Apply for Medicaid LTSS through RI DHS (call 855-697-4347 or The Point at 401-462-4444), then choose the Personal Choice self-directed option through one of the three partner agencies.

name: South Carolina
agency: South Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (SCDHHS), Community Long Term Care (CLTC) — Healthy Connections 888-549-0820

spouse.detail: limited — spouses cannot provide companion care but may provide attendant care services; legal guardians excluded

parentMinor.detail: yes for minors via the separate MCC Waiver — parents/relatives/guardians paid hourly for children's attendant care (ages 1-21, max 40 hrs/wk per caregiver, from 7/1/2025); Community Choices itself serves adults 18+

pay.detail: not published — depends on participant budget and negotiated rate

agencyModel: self-directed with a required financial management services agency handling payroll/taxes (FMS vendor name not confirmed)

waitlist.detail: not an entitlement — limited slots (~25,401/yr) and a waitlist forms when full

apply: Contact the regional Community Long Term Care (CLTC) office or Healthy Connections at 888-549-0820 and file the Application for Nursing Home, Residential or In-Home Care; MCC families request self-direction through their Waiver Nurse Case Manager.

name: South Dakota
agency: South Dakota Dept. of Human Services, Division of Long-Term Services & Supports (financial eligibility via Dept. of Social Services); Dakota at Home 833-663-9673

spouse.detail: yes — spouses may serve as the paid SFC caregiver; caregiver and recipient must live in the same home

parentMinor.detail: no — HOPE Waiver serves only adults 65+ or disabled adults 18-64, so a minor child cannot be the care recipient

pay.detail: SFC per-diem tiers effective 7/1/2026: base $82.00/day, tier 1 $102.52/day, tier 2 $114.81/day, with a minimum 50% paid to the caregiver; ~up to $392/week tax-free stipend reported

agencyModel: yes — SFC is delivered through an approved SFC provider agency (e.g. Careforth) that pays the caregiver, though the caregiver is not an agency employee; live-in required

waitlist.detail: capped at ~3,704 beneficiaries/year; a waitlist can form

apply: Call Dakota at Home at 833-663-9673 or your local DSS office; financial eligibility goes through DSS and the LTSS functional assessment through DHS at the same time.

name: Tennessee
agency: TennCare Long-Term Services & Supports (LTSS) Division; AAAD intake 1-866-836-6678; LTSS Help Desk 1-877-224-0219

spouse.detail: no — spouses, legal guardians, and powers of attorney cannot be hired; adult children and other relatives can

parentMinor.detail: limited — CHOICES serves only adults 21+ with disabilities and seniors 65+; children go through Katie Beckett / ECF CHOICES, whose consumer direction may pay family

pay.detail: member-set wage within approved budget via CDTN wage memo; reported ~$11-$15/hr typical, TennCare-approved max ~$19.16/hr for personal care visits

agencyModel: consumer-directed, but all consumer-direction payroll must run through the fiscal employer agent Consumer Direct Care Network Tennessee (CDTN)

waitlist.detail: not an entitlement — CHOICES Groups 2/3 have limited enrollment slots and a waitlist can form

apply: Current TennCare members contact their managed care organization (health plan); everyone else calls their local Area Agency on Aging and Disability at 1-866-836-6678 to start CHOICES screening.

name: Texas
agency: Texas Health & Human Services Commission (HHSC); interest lists 877-438-5658 (CLASS/MDCP) and 800-964-2777 (STAR+PLUS HCBS)

spouse.detail: no — spouses cannot be paid attendants in Medicaid CDS programs; reported exception: state-funded CMPAS may allow a spouse

parentMinor.detail: no — a legally responsible parent (or foster parent, or spouse of a parent) cannot be the paid attendant for their minor child (e.g. CAS rule); parents of adult children CAN be paid

pay.detail: reported ~$10.60 (state base wage floor) to ~$15.00/hr depending on program, MCO, and approved budget

agencyModel: self-directed, but every CDS employer must use a financial management services agency (FMSA) for payroll, taxes, and background checks

waitlist.detail: severe — STAR+PLUS HCBS interest list wait is 'many years' (~5,034 reported); CLASS ~48,169 and MDCP ~27,012 on interest lists with waits reported up to ~13-15 years

apply: Call 877-438-5658 to join the CLASS or MDCP interest list, or 800-964-2777 for the STAR+PLUS HCBS interest list; benefits applications go through YourTexasBenefits.com or 2-1-1 Texas.

name: Utah
agency: Utah Dept. of Health & Human Services — Division of Integrated Healthcare (Medicaid, 800-662-9651) and Division of Services for People with Disabilities (DSPD, 1-844-275-3773)

spouse.detail: yes/limited — spouses payable under DSPD Caregiver Compensation (SB 63, CMS-approved Jan 2022) for extraordinary care; New Choices Waiver allows spouses 'in some cases'; EPAS and state-plan personal care exclude spouses

parentMinor.detail: yes — parents, step-parents, and legal guardians can be paid under DSPD Caregiver Compensation (since 2020) after completing required training; not under state-plan personal care

pay.detail: no published hourly schedule found; parents receiving DSPD caregiver compensation reportedly averaged ~$2,372/month for extraordinary care

agencyModel: participant-directed with a financial management services agency handling payroll (New Choices Waiver); DSPD caregiver compensation runs through the person's DSPD services and requires caregiver training

waitlist.detail: New Choices Waiver is not an entitlement (~2,500 slots, waitlist possible); DSPD services are known for a multi-year waiting list

apply: For disability waivers call DSPD intake at 1-844-275-3773 or apply online at dspd.utah.gov; for the New Choices Waiver call Utah Medicaid at 800-662-9651 (option 6) after meeting facility-residency requirements.

name: Vermont
agency: Vermont Dept. of Disabilities, Aging & Independent Living (DAIL); Senior HelpLine 800-642-5119; ESD Benefits Service Center 800-479-6151 (financial eligibility)

spouse.detail: yes — relatives including an adult child or spouse can be hired in the Highest Needs group / Flexible Choices; spouses are NOT payable in the Moderate Needs group; legal guardians excluded

parentMinor.detail: no via CFC — the program serves adults (18+ with physical disabilities and seniors); children's personal care runs through separate programs

pay.detail: minimum wage on the CFC wage notice $15.49/hr effective 7/6/2025; most self-directed caregivers reportedly earn ~$16-$18/hr, set within the approved budget

agencyModel: self-directed — participant or surrogate is the employer; ARIS Solutions serves as the fiscal intermediary handling payroll, taxes, and background checks

waitlist.detail: Highest Needs applicants are prioritized; HCBS slots may be limited and a waitlist can form when full (Moderate Needs is capped)

apply: Submit a Vermont Long-Term Care Medicaid application (DAIL does the clinical assessment, ESD at 800-479-6151 the financial eligibility); the Senior HelpLine at 800-642-5119 can help start the process.

name: Virginia
agency: Virginia Department of Medical Assistance Services (DMAS), Office of Community Living; CCC Plus Helpline 1-844-374-9159

spouse.detail: limited — spouses payable only as Legally Responsible Individuals for 'extraordinary care' (ADLs only, not IADLs/supervision) when circumstances prevent a non-LRI caregiver; capped at 40 hrs/week; LRI rules updated eff. 7/1/2025

parentMinor.detail: limited — parents of minors payable under the same LRI rules (extraordinary care, ADLs only, up to 40 hrs/week per child); no respite allowed alongside a paid LRI

pay.detail: not published on fetched pages; Medicaid consumer-directed attendant rate varies by region

agencyModel: no home-care agency; fully consumer-directed but a fiscal/employer agent is mandatory — PPL (Public Partnerships) or Consumer Direct Care Network depending on the member's managed-care plan, plus a services facilitator

waitlist.detail: not an entitlement — a waitlist can form when slots fill, though it has historically had no waiting list

apply: Apply for Medicaid via Cover Virginia or the local Virginia Department of Social Services (VDSS) office and request a functional (nursing-facility level of care) screening through local DSS.

name: Washington
agency: WA Dept. of Social and Health Services, Aging and Long-Term Support Administration (ALTSA); HCS regional intake: Region 1 Spokane 800-459-0421, Region 2 Seattle 800-346-9257, Region 3 Tacoma 800-422-5129; CDWA 866-214-9899

spouse.detail: no — DSHS: 'Spouses cannot be paid to care for each other'; some spouses may qualify via Veteran Directed Care or WA Cares Fund instead

parentMinor.detail: no — DSHS: 'Parents cannot be paid to care for a child under 18'

pay.detail: SEIU 775/CDWA wage scale: $22.52-$26.09/hr from 7/1/2025, rising to $23.54-$27.28/hr on 7/1/2026 (step by cumulative career hours), plus benefits

agencyModel: no traditional agency, but all Individual Providers must be employed through CDWA (Consumer Directed Employer; handles contracting, background check, training, payroll) while the client directs day-to-day care

waitlist.detail: CFC is an entitlement — no waitlist; MAC & TSOA paused enrollment and started a waitlist 12/1/2025

apply: The care recipient applies for Apple Health LTSS through a DSHS Home & Community Services regional intake office and gets a CARE assessment; the family caregiver then applies as an Individual Provider at consumerdirectwa.com.

name: West Virginia
agency: WV Bureau of Senior Services (operates ADW) under the Dept. of Human Services / Bureau for Medical Services; 1-866-767-1575 or 304-558-3317

spouse.detail: no — 'a spouse or legal guardian is excluded' (ex-spouses allowed)

parentMinor.detail: no for this program — ADW serves ages 18+ only; no minor-child pathway via ADW

pay.detail: set by the participant within their monthly budget; must be at least WV minimum wage ($8.75 as of 2024 per medicaidplanningassistance.org); capped by Medicaid regulation

agencyModel: no home-care agency under Personal Options; a financial management services agency is required — Palco (WV Personal Options FMS since 2024; previously PPL/Public Partnerships)

waitlist.detail: yes but short — waiver capped (~8,750 slots); state reports average waitlist time last fiscal year was ~44 days, application process averages ~56 days

apply: Doctor completes a Medical Necessity Evaluation Request (MNER) and submits it to Acentra Health-ADW; financial eligibility application goes through the county DoHS (DHHR) office first.

name: Wisconsin
agency: Wisconsin Department of Health Services, Division of Medicaid Services (IRIS Management Section); IRIS Call Center 888-515-4747

spouse.detail: yes — relatives, including spouses, can be hired per medicaidplanningassistance.org

parentMinor.detail: limited — IRIS serves adults 18+ only; a parent caring for a minor disabled child would go through the separate Children's Long-Term Support (CLTS) waiver

pay.detail: not published on fetched pages; wage set within the participant's IRIS budget through the fiscal employer agent

agencyModel: no agency required — participant is the employer; a fiscal employer agent is mandatory: currently GT Independence, iLIFE, or Premier Financial Management Services; DHS is moving to a single statewide FEA (~April 2026)

waitlist.detail: no waitlist — IRIS is an entitlement: meeting eligibility requirements equates to immediate receipt of benefits

apply: Contact the local Aging and Disability Resource Center (ADRC) or Tribal aging and disability resource specialist for eligibility screening and an in-person functional assessment, then choose IRIS over Family Care.

name: Wyoming
agency: Wyoming Department of Health, Division of Healthcare Financing, Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS) Section; 1-800-510-0280; Long Term Care Eligibility Unit 1-855-203-2936

spouse.detail: yes per medicaidplanningassistance.org ('Friends and family, including one's adult child or spouse, can be hired'), but other sources exclude spouses/legal guardians/POAs —

parentMinor.detail: no — CCW serves only people 65+ or adults 19-64 with an SSA-verified disability; minors are not in this waiver

pay.detail: not published on fetched pages; paid through the FMS within the participant's budget

agencyModel: no home-care agency for self-directed care, but an FMS is required — ACES$ Financial Management Services serves the CCW; a case management agency must also be selected at application

waitlist.detail: yes — not an entitlement; slots are limited and a waitlist forms when they are full

apply: Submit the CCW Program Application (CCW Form 01, which requires choosing a county case management agency) to the WDH HCBS Section in Cheyenne; non-Medicaid members also file a Wyoming Medicaid LTC application (1-855-203-2936); an LT-101 nurse assessment determines level of care.
